competing_explanation: Decoded RGB identity validates the frozen leakage-control rule but does not establish original capture provenance or physical filename-token semantics; the four clear aliases may be packaging duplicates. The full official test is baseline-exposed because the official checkpoint aggregate metric was reproduced, so only candidate outcomes—not baseline exposure—remain unseen.
